{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cerise Fog Project''' was a experimental facility that was used by the company [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Publicly, Bespin Motors' parent company, the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], claimed that the project was a prototype for the design of components for use in the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. However, a number of rumors claimed that the facility had military applications and housed experimental vehicles that had been developed to counter those of Incom's rival firm [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]]. However, at some point the facility crashed into the surface of Fresia and was destroyed, creating a debris field that stretched across a 30 kilometer area surrounding the [[Buichol Isthmus]]. According to official statements from Incom at the time of the project's failure, most of the project's wreckage landed in the seas of Fresia and was quickly pulverized by the planet's tides.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
